lessons.content:
<!-- scaffold -->

> Scaffold. One sample question is written so the format is clear; the remaining
> questions are not written yet.

## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in SEO — Search Engine Optimization, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. A page has been crawled but does not appear in search results at all. What has not happened?
- Ranking
+ Indexing
- Crawling
= Crawling is fetching the page; indexing is storing it so it can be returned. Without indexing there is nothing to rank.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.

Marked out of 100. The bands below are placeholders until the assignment is written.

- Research and understanding of the audience — 20 marks
